description.value: Diamond Steak & Seafood House is a family-owned restaurant on Main Street in Osoyoos with over 45 years of community history, currently run by Gus and Maria who purchased it in 1997. The menu spans steaks, seafood, and Greek-inspired dishes, and the kitchen's house recipe — Three Diamond Dressing — has grown into a product sold commercially across Western Canada. A fireplace dining room and full bar make it a comfortable evening destination for cyclists finishing a day in the South Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is well-populated and confirms an active business: full address, phone, menu, and 45-year history are clearly documented. No bike-specific amenities (racks, Wi-Fi, charging, takeout) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null. A dedicated gluten-aware menu page confirms GF options. Two concerns stand out: a name discrepancy between OSM ('Diamond Steak and Seafood') and the website ('Diamond Steak & Seafood House'), and boilerplate template content in the website footer referencing a Paris restaurant and Italian phone number, which appears to be an unfilled website theme placeholder rather than a data integrity issue.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Diamond Steak and Seafood' but the website consistently uses 'Diamond Steak & Seafood House'.

Website footer contains apparent leftover theme-template placeholder content referencing 'Andé Restaurant, 767 5th Avenue, Paris', an Italian phone number (+39 399 461 1608), and an unrelated email (Basilicorestaurant@gmail.com) — likely an unfilled website builder block, not a business data issue.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags; all contact details sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating restaurant on Main Street in Osoyoos — a known South Okanagan cycling destination — making it a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'GLUTEN AWARE MENU' page lists gluten-aware versions of appetizers, salads, Greek plates, entrees, and Sterling Silver beef dishes; GF bread also listed as a side on the main menu

wow_evidence: house recipe — Three Diamond Dressing — has grown into a product sold commercially across Western Canada
